experiment.name: reserve
experiment.hypothesis: The second repair attempt carries part of the bounded retry design on its own, separately from the pacing effect of the reservation shrinking the budget the agent reads.
experiment.rule: Call the retry turn load-bearing on its own only if the 95 percent interval on control minus treatment excludes zero. An interval that includes zero is reported as unresolved, and the difference against the fully ablated arm is reported as suggestive because the two were measured in different batches.

decision.reason: removing it cost +25.7 points (95% CI +3.3 to +44.9), an interval that excludes zero, so it is load-bearing
